title: Marks Chicken
description: Chicken thighs baked over sliced new potatoes with anchovies, olives, lemon wedges and cherry tomatoes, finished with melted mozzarella.
ingredients: 8 chicken thigh fillets, fat trimmed away
2 lemons, each cut into 4 wedges lengthways
100g (3.5oz) mozzarella cheese, torn into small pieces
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan (400°F), Gas Mark 6.
In a medium casserole dish (with a lid), layer the sliced new potatoes and pour over the chicken stock. Lay the chicken thighs over the potatoes in a circle and place an anchovy fillet on each thigh.

Scatter the olives over and place the lemon wedges around the chicken. Space the garlic slices evenly, add the cherry tomatoes and sprinkle the oregano over everything. Season, spray with oil, place the lid on and bake in the oven for 1 hour.
Remove from the oven, scatter the mozzarella over the top, then return to the oven for 15 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Serve straight away (don't eat the lemon pieces) and spoon over the pan gravy with each serving.
notes: Mark's original version contains chorizo — feel free to add it back. Leftover anchovies can be used to make a simple puttanesca pasta sauce.
